What we do

Pest control services for homes & businesses

From termites in the walls to roaches in the kitchen, one call covers it. Fast scheduling, online or mail billing, and local personnel who make it easy.

Termites

Eradicate termites and have your damage repaired — thorough inspection, targeted treatment, and repairs handled by one team.

Cockroaches

We can quickly remove roaches from your home or office, then find and seal the spots that let them in.

Ants, Spiders & Earwigs

Ants, spiders, earwigs, and more — we will solve your pest problem with treatments matched to the pest and your home.

Rodents

Rats and mice located, removed, and kept out — with exclusion work so they do not come back.

Bats & Birds

Safe, humane bat and bird removal for attics, eaves, and rooflines — done the right way, the first time.

Escrow Inspections

Clear, detailed termite and pest inspections for home sales — the paperwork your escrow needs, on schedule.

Why Craig & Sons?

A family business with 150+ years of combined experience

Craig & Sons is a family-run company. Craig Swanston, the founder, has worked in the pest control industry for more than 50 years — and today the company continues to serve Southern California with exceptional pest control services, including escrow inspections.

All of our technicians participate in frequent, continued education to renew their licenses and deliver state-of-the-art pest control.

  • Local — locally owned, operated, and staffed
  • Safe — technicians trained in best practices for your home or office
  • Experienced — more than 150 years of combined experience
  • Convenient — fast scheduling, online or mail billing
